# LoadingRegion

Wrap any region that loads.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.LoadingRegion` · Status

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.LoadingRegion>…</AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.LoadingRegion>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.LoadingRegion">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Applies the loading timing rules (300 ms delay, 600 ms minimum, 200 ms fade) with aria-busy and spoken status.

## Props (LoadingRegionProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | `boolean` | True while the data is on its way. |
| `skeleton` | `React.ReactNode` | What to show while loading: a SkeletonPreset or your own Skeletons. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `label` | `string` | Spoken when loading starts, e.g. "Loading case studies". @default "Loading" |
| `doneLabel` | `string` | Spoken when it finishes. @default "Loaded" |
| `delay` | `number` | Show nothing for this long, so fast loads feel instant. @default 300 |
| `minDuration` | `number` | Once shown, keep the skeleton at least this long, so it never flashes. @default 600 |
| `keepPrevious` | `boolean` | On a refetch, keep the current content (dimmed, with an "Updating" hint) instead of a skeleton. @default true |
| `refreshing` | `React.ReactNode` | Text of the refetch hint. @default "Updating" |
| `as` | `string` | Element tag. @default "div" |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>._
